content.text: <user_input mode="act">Let's make Willow Table nicer to play now that the rules checks pass. Please continue the existing game in this folder. The green table feels right, but at 1280 by 720 my hand and controls fall below the screen. Make the desktop layout more compact and the phone layout comfortable without shrinking the tile labels; scrolling the hand itself is fine on a narrow screen. I'd like to select a tile first and then press Discard, with arrow keys, Home/End, Enter and Escape working naturally. Keep focus usable when turns change, and announce turn and claim updates politely to screen readers. Add a small Settings panel with slow/normal/fast computer turns, standard/large tile text, and reduced motion that follows my device by default. Save those preferences locally. Show everyone's full discard history, including mine, and explain unfamiliar claim buttons in plain English. Keep the interface entirely English and local, and run the relevant checks.</user_input>

## Plan

I’ll first inspect the existing application structure, game UI, tests, and scripts so the changes match the project’s current framework and conventions. Then I’ll identify the relevant layout, keyboard/focus, accessibility, settings/persistence, and discard-history code paths; implement the requested responsive and interaction improvements; and finally run the applicable checks and inspect the edited files.
